title: Airbus A220 區域客機工程
subcategoryTitle: 民航機與世界航空案例
subcategoryTitleEn: Civil aircraft and world aviation cases
summary: 以A220區域至中短程客機為背景，練習機體尺寸、乘載變動與整合取捨；虛構模型不代表該機型實際翼載或航程。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use the A220 regional-to-short/medium-haul context to practice size, payload variability and integration tradeoffs; the hypothetical model does not represent actual wing loading or range. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

steps.title: 短程任務的載重變化：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Payload variations in a short-haul mission: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 短程任務的載重變化 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Payload variations in a short-haul mission and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 翼載是重量除翼面積；載客、貨物或任務設備改變會同時影響升力需求與結構載荷。
steps.instructionEn: Wing loading is weight divided by wing area; passengers, cargo or mission equipment change both lift demand and structural loading.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Airbus A220 區域客機工程實際性能或製程：m=1200 kg，g=9.81 m/s²，S=16 m²。式 W/S=mg/S，基準結果 735.75 N/m²。適用條件：靜態重量正規化，非性能或適航允許值。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Airbus A220 regional airliner engineering: m=1200 kg, g=9.81 m/s² and S=16 m². Formula W/S=mg/S gives 735.75 N/m². Conditions: Static weight normalization, not a performance or airworthiness limit.
steps.failure: 把公斤直接當牛頓會漏掉重力因子。
steps.failureEn: Treating kilograms as newtons omits gravity.
steps.check: 核對質量清單和面積定義，把新增設備與移除設備分列。
steps.checkEn: Check mass inventory and area definition and list added and removed equipment separately.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再只把m改成1320 kg；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 735.75 改為 809.325 N/m²。在算式區重算並記下對「短程任務的載重變化」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only m to 1320 kg, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 735.75 to 809.325 N/m². Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Payload variations in a short-haul mission, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

steps.title: 翼展與機場幾何限制：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Span and airport geometry constraints: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 翼展與機場幾何限制 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Span and airport geometry constraints and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 展弦比以翼展平方除參考面積，表達有限翼三維效應；縮尺模型保留幾何比例不會自動保留流動相似性。
steps.instructionEn: Aspect ratio is span squared divided by reference area and describes finite-wing geometry; geometric scaling alone does not preserve flow similarity.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Airbus A220 區域客機工程實際性能或製程：翼展b=12 m，面積S=18 m²。式 AR=b²/S，基準結果 8 dimensionless。適用條件：投影翼面積且翼展定義一致；不是翼梢形狀的完整模型。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Airbus A220 regional airliner engineering: Span b=12 m and reference area S=18 m². Formula AR=b²/S gives 8 dimensionless. Conditions: Consistent projected area and span definitions; not a full model of wingtip geometry.
steps.failure: 混用單翼面積與全翼翼展會把展弦比放大兩倍。
steps.failureEn: Combining half-wing area with full span doubles the calculated aspect ratio.
steps.check: 在同一投影圖量翼展與面積，把翼梢裝置的投影規則列在表格。
steps.checkEn: Measure span and area on one projection and document how wingtip devices are included.

Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Span and airport geometry constraints, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.
